entities.summary: Juan Ricardo Miguel Zulueta Vergarajauregui known as Iván Zulueta was a designer and film director. His work spanned different fields such as art designer in movies or music and he was mainly known for writing and directing the film Arrebato (Rapture), and for designing the posters and promotion of Pedro Almodóvar's first movies.
